question.prompt: \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\) are congruent, with \(\angle A=\angle E\), \(\angle B=\angle D\), and \(\angle C=\angle F\). Write the congruence statement with corresponding vertices in order: △ABC≌△___ (fill in three letters).

solutions.explanation: \(A\) corresponds to \(E\), \(B\) corresponds to \(D\), and \(C\) corresponds to \(F\), so \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle EDF\).
solutions.title: Write vertices in corresponding order
